children: G III Apparel Group reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $554.09M and diluted EPS of $0.46, compared with $613.27M in revenue and $0.25 EPS in the prior-year quarter; net income was $20.21M versus $10.94M a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted income per common share”.
Wholesale net sales declined year-over-year, driven in part by expired Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger licenses that reduced unit shipments.
The company is shifting toward digital, increasing investments in digital marketing, logistics and ecommerce; comparable store and digital sales rose for DKNY, Donna Karan and Karl Lagerfeld.
Growth in owned and newer licensed brands — including Donna Karan, BCBG, Converse and French Connection — partially offset the lost licensed revenue.
G III completed the acquisition structure to operate the Marc Jacobs business under license from IPCo and began operating the business post-closing.
Gross margin benefited from major IEEPA tariff refunds; the company continues to face tariff exposures and Asian shipping disruptions affecting timing and costs.
